svg.title: JE Pipeline Workflow — expanded
svg.desc: Three-pipeline flowchart with generous spacing showing Journal Entry data flow through filtering, matching iterations, and AA comment rules.

g.text: row_id · entered_net_dec · eff_dt · month_dt · primary_key — all non-null
PK = Company Desc + Vendor Num + abs(Net Entered)

svg.text: Match iteration loop — steps applied in order, each exhaustive until no new pairs
Per step: rank by amount_diff asc → month_lag asc → eff_dt asc · pick 1-to-1 · repeat until no new pairs found
Pipeline 2 — cross-year matching (CY unmatched + optional PY carry-forward)

g.text: CY unmatched → Year Flag = CURRENT_FY · Source Quarter = CQ
PY carry-forward (if supplied) → Year Flag = PRIOR_FY · Source Quarter = CF_Q
valid rows → blank invoice ref → PK cardinality split

svg.text: Match iteration loop — same 4 steps as P1

g.text: Steps 5–8: identical match conditions to P1
Year Pair Flag derived per pair
PY SI + CY CM · CY SI + CY CM · PY SI + PY CM · CY SI + PY CM

svg.text: Derived from Year Flag on each pair's sales row and credit row after matching
Pipeline 3 — tolerance / approx matching (looser PK, no amount in key)

g.text: p3_primary_key = Company Desc + Vendor Num only

svg.text: AA Comment assignment — all P3 rows merged · first match wins

g.text: All rows (SI + CM) · match_type = ONE_TO_MANY → "Requires Audit Team Review"

svg.text: Rules 3P1 – 3P5 apply to NO_MATCH_FOUND rows · JE Category = Credit Memos only

g.text: P1 — vendor has 0 sales invoices and > 0 credit memos
P2 — vendor has exactly 1 unique credit combination
P4 — eff_dt month = first month of row's own Source Quarter
